cards.title: Anthropic's IPO Breaks Records with $105B Valuation
cards.body: Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million at the upgraded $83/share IPO price. The company raised nearly $105 billion in the record-breaking offering.

cards.title: Anthropic's Charity Foundation Could Receive $156B
cards.body: At a $95 stock price, Anthropic's Public Benefit Foundation, employee donations, and company match total $156 billion. This represents a historic commitment to charitable giving from an AI frontier lab.

cards.title: Google Launches Gemini Mac Agent with Workflow Automation
cards.body: Google's latest Gemini update brings an AI agent to Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and handle multistep workflows. Users can now delegate complex tasks directly to their desktop assistant.

cards.title: Apple Developing Its Own AI Agent for Mac
cards.body: Apple appears to be building AI agents to compete with Meta Muse, Claude, and OpenAI Dots. The iPhone maker is quietly advancing its agent capabilities.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Wearable Rumored at $300 Price
cards.body: Meta's upcoming Muse Charm device may cost around $300, according to reporting from The Information. The company declined to deny the report, saying it will share more details soon.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Agent Exposes Private Data in Major Glitch
cards.body: Meta's AI agent Muse is mixing up user conversations and surfacing incorrect personal information. Employees reported seeing unrelated childcare requests, career advice, product orders, and bank balances.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resigns from Nvidia Amid Scandal
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following an affair with potential national security implications. The incident could affect the U.S.-China race for advanced AI infrastructure development.

cards.title: Nvidia Stops H200 Chip Sales to China
cards.body: Despite healthy earnings growth, Nvidia announced it will halt H200 chip sales to China. The decision comes amid broader geopolitical tensions and regulatory pressures.

cards.title: OpenAI Chief Scientist Proposes AI Development Speed Limits
cards.body: OpenAI's chief scientist outlined how to establish speed limits on AI development. The proposal requires agreement on how to measure and enforce development pace.

cards.title: Signal Restricts Screenshots Over AI Surveillance Threat
cards.body: Signal is limiting screenshot capabilities in both Android and iOS apps to combat AI surveillance. The company views this as an essential step against an existential threat.

cards.title: Top AI Agents Now Available via Text Messages
cards.body: A new wave of AI agents can now live directly in text messaging apps. Options range from general assistants to specialized agents for families, travel, and work.

cards.title: AI Solves 167-Year-Old Riemann Hypothesis Problem
cards.body: An AI system has claimed to solve the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics' oldest unsolved problems. Remarkably, a human mathematician also independently discovered a competing solution.

cards.title: Daniel Ek Backs Fusion Power Startup Europa Fusion
cards.body: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is investing in Europa Fusion, an AI researcher-founded fusion power startup. The partnership aims to advance clean energy solutions for data centers.

cards.title: Hollywood Actors License Faces to AI Microdrama Startup
cards.body: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup in a trend already popular in China. Experts question the long-term consequences if this becomes mainstream in Hollywood.

cards.title: Six AI Gadgets for Smarter Home Office Setup
cards.body: New AI-powered gadgets from notetakers to webcams can upgrade your workspace. These tools are designed to boost productivity and streamline daily workflows.

cards.title: Recent Tech Outages Mirror Y2K-Style AI Agent Failures
cards.body: Airlines, banking platforms, and productivity services experienced outages that could signal deeper AI agent issues. Cybersecurity experts suggest these incidents may be interconnected.

cards.title: Data Centers Become Central to Big Tech Backlash
cards.body: Journalist Paris Marx explores the growing controversy around hyperscale data centers in his new book. The facilities are increasingly criticized for environmental and societal impact.

cards.title: Space Data Center Financing Faces Collateral Challenges
cards.body: Lenders are hesitant to finance chips destined for orbit via SpaceX launches. This financing gap raises questions about the viability of space-based data centers.

cards.title: Notable Capital, GIC, Baillie Gifford Back Anthropic IPO
cards.body: Three major investors share their conviction for betting billions on Anthropic before its IPO. Their backing signals confidence in the frontier AI lab's trajectory.

cards.title: Nvidia's Mixed Earnings Signal Amid Executive Turmoil
cards.body: Despite healthy earnings growth, Nvidia faces uncertainty from Jensen Huang's departure. The chipmaker's future direction remains unclear as leadership transitions occur.

cards.title: AI capabilities continue exponential improvement trajectory
cards.body: METR's updated report shows AI models are excelling at coding but lag in judgment-based tasks. Some AI capabilities continue following an exponential growth curve, challenging previous plateau assumptions.

cards.title: AI startup develops smell detection as good as humans
cards.body: A New Jersey lab trained AI with detailed odor classifications from experienced human sniffers. The AI nose matches human olfactory capabilities by cross-referencing sensory notes with chemical analysis.

cards.title: Google launches AI-integrated search homepage redesign
cards.body: Google's new search interface incorporates AI chat history directly into the homepage. The redesign removes the traditional search button, emphasizing conversational AI interaction.

cards.title: Meta faces emissions spike from AI data centers
cards.body: Meta is reconsidering its 2030 net-zero commitment due to record emissions from AI infrastructure. The company's expanding AI data centers are creating significant environmental challenges.

cards.title: Researcher exposes AI supply chain privacy vulnerability
cards.body: A researcher planted 2 million canaries into the AI supply chain, revealing widespread privacy issues. The discovery highlights how training data can be compromised across AI development pipelines.
